items.title: Trump says immigration crackdown 'might be too tough' after midterms
items.feedTitle: Trump says his immigration crackdown ‘might be too tough’ after midterm losses
items.summary: President Trump told CBS News his deportation policies may have been "too tough" and contributed to Republican losses in the midterm elections. Trump said the policy "both helped and hurt" the party electorally. The statement marks a significant reversal from his earlier hardline immigration rhetoric and could signal a potential policy shift in his second term.

items.title: Native American women make historic election gains nationwide
items.feedTitle: Native American women made history in tribal, state and federal elections
items.summary: Native American women achieved unprecedented electoral success in Tuesday's midterm elections, including Peggy Flanagan becoming the first Native American woman elected to the U.S. Senate, Deb Haaland winning a state governorship, and Crystalyne Curley leading the Navajo Nation. Advocates characterized the results as a watershed moment for Native representation in American politics at federal, state, and tribal levels.

items.title: Midterms energize abuse survivors as political constituency
items.feedTitle: The midterms energized a powerful political constituency: abuse survivors
items.summary: The 2026 midterm elections saw significant victories for abuse survivor advocates, from Ohio Governor-elect Amy Acton's win to candidates accused of domestic violence withdrawing from races. Activists called the results "a win for survivors" and pointed to growing voter appetite for holding elected officials accountable on abuse and violence issues.

items.title: Strokes among younger adults have nearly doubled in recent years
items.feedTitle: Sen. Chris Murphy's stroke at 53 highlights a trend: Strokes among younger adults have risen
items.summary: Research shows stroke incidence among adults nearly doubled from 1993-94 to 2020, jumping from 33.90 to 62.18 cases per 100,000 people. The concerning trend was highlighted after Senator Chris Murphy suffered a stroke at age 53, drawing attention to the rising prevalence of cerebrovascular events in younger populations.

items.title: Multiple shootings at Winston-Salem State University kill one
items.feedTitle: 1 dead, 3 others injured following two separate shootings at Winston-Salem State University
items.summary: Two separate shooting incidents on the campus of Winston-Salem State University resulted in one death and three injuries. A suspect was arrested in connection with the attacks, which occurred during the university's homecoming weekend and prompted police to seek community support.

stlouis.title: Man critically injured in downtown St. Louis shooting
stlouis.feedTitle: Man critically injured in Downtown St. Louis, Missouri shooting
stlouis.summary: A man was critically injured in a shooting incident in downtown St. Louis. Emergency responders treated the victim at the scene, with details on the circumstances and shooter still being investigated by local authorities.

stlouis.title: St. Louis CITY SC earns playoff berth with stoppage-time winner
stlouis.feedTitle: Lukas MacNaughton's stoppage-time winner sends St. Louis CITY SC into playoffs as West's No. 3 seed
stlouis.summary: Lukas MacNaughton scored a stoppage-time goal to send St. Louis CITY SC into the MLS playoffs as the Western Conference's No. 3 seed. The dramatic finish secured the club's postseason entry and advancement in the league standings.

stlouis.title: MetroBus Route 71 returns to service on November 30
stlouis.feedTitle: St. Louis Brings Back MetroBus Route 71 on Nov. 30
stlouis.summary: St. Louis is restoring MetroBus Route 71 service beginning November 30, expanding transit options for riders in the region. The route's return comes after a period of suspension from the regional bus network.

items.title: Iran vows 'astonishing' strikes, lifts missile-range limits
items.feedTitle: Iran vows ‘astonishing’ strikes and lifts missile-range limit as US targets land routes
items.summary: Iranian officials have vowed to launch "astonishing" military strikes and announced they are lifting restrictions on missile ranges amid escalating tensions with the United States. The statements come as Iran responds to U.S. military operations and raises the stakes in an already volatile regional conflict.

items.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO Jensen Huang affair
items.feedTitle: Nvidia opens investigation after report CEO Jensen Huang was target of foreign intelligence
items.summary: Nvidia's board announced an independent investigation after reports that CEO Jensen Huang admitted to having an intimate relationship with a woman U.S. intelligence officials believe was spying for China. The probe was initiated in response to foreign intelligence concerns raised about the executive.

items.title: Two Polish officers hailed as heroes after Kraków shooting
items.feedTitle: Two police officers hailed as heroes for confronting Kraków gunman
items.summary: Two Polish police officers were injured while pursuing and apprehending a gunman in Kraków who killed six people in a mass shooting at the Main Market Square. Officers Jakub Kulik and Artur Morański were praised for their actions preventing further casualties, with a nearby surgeon providing critical medical aid.

items.title: Train collision near Cairo kills seven, injures 125
items.feedTitle: Collision between 2 trains in Egypt kills 7 and injures at least 125
items.summary: Two trains collided south of Cairo, Egypt, resulting in at least seven deaths and more than 125 injuries. Several carriages derailed in the al-Ayyat district about 50 kilometers from the capital, prompting a presidential investigation into the incident.

items.title: Pope Leo visits Argentina, urges safeguarding democracy
items.feedTitle: President Milei welcomes Pope Leo during historic visit to Argentina
items.summary: Pope Leo XIV began a historically significant visit to Argentina, marking the first papal trip to the country in nearly four decades. During the visit, the pope urged President Milei to safeguard democracy and build bridges, amid tensions between the Church and the populist administration.

items.title: Delhi air pollution 50 times WHO limit on Diwali night
items.feedTitle: Air pollution over 50 times WHO limit in parts of Delhi as people defy ban on firecrackers on Deepavali
items.summary: Air pollution in parts of Delhi reached levels over 50 times the WHO guideline during Diwali celebrations, with the overall air quality index remaining in the "very poor" category. Despite a government ban on firecrackers, many residents continued to burst fireworks, contributing to severe air quality degradation across the city.

items.title: Major fire breaks out in Mumbai's Dongri area
items.feedTitle: Major fire breaks out in Mumbai's Dongri, dousing ops on; one dead in November 7 highrise blaze
items.summary: A Level-I fire erupted in Mumbai's Dongri neighborhood on November 7, claiming at least one life. The Mumbai Fire Brigade deployed multiple personnel alongside police and ambulance services for extensive dousing operations in the densely populated area.

items.title: Diwali 2026: Indians celebrate festival of lights nationwide
items.feedTitle: Diwali 2026: Indians celebrate festival with lights and fireworks
items.summary: Indians across the country celebrated Diwali with traditional prayers, lights, and fireworks marking one of the country's biggest Hindu festivals. Despite air quality concerns, millions participated in the festival, which fell on November 8 in 2026.

items.title: India's clean energy push saved $240 billion in fuel imports
items.feedTitle: India's clean energy push cut its fuel import bill by $240 billion: IEA
items.summary: According to the International Energy Agency, India's renewable energy investments have cut the nation's fuel import bill by approximately $240 billion. The achievement underscores India's progress toward clean energy targets while reducing dependence on fossil fuel imports.

items.title: India evacuates 19 seafarers stranded in Yemen
items.feedTitle: India evacuates 19 stranded seafarers from Yemen
items.summary: India successfully evacuated 19 seafarers who were stranded in Yemen, according to the Embassy of India. The evacuation followed recent incidents involving Indian nationals aboard vessels in the region and reflected ongoing efforts to bring Indian citizens to safety from the conflict-affected area.

immigration.title: Trump admin updates USCIS I-129 form for work visa applications
immigration.feedTitle: Trump administration updates USCIS form: Employers must use the new I-129 to apply for work visas starting in November
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has finalized and implemented new I-129 form requirements that employers must use starting in November 2026 when applying for work visas. This represents a procedural change affecting H-1B and other employment-based visa categories, with compliance required for all new petitions filed after the effective date.

immigration.title: Stephen Miller elevation signals tighter immigration enforcement
immigration.feedTitle: Stephen Miller Becomes White House Chief of Staff: What It Means for Legal Immigrants
immigration.summary: Stephen Miller's promotion to White House Chief of Staff, proposed and not yet final in implementation details, signals the Trump administration's intent to pursue hardline immigration policies. Immigration advocates and Democratic lawmakers have expressed concern about tighter enforcement, visa restrictions, and potential changes to work permit programs under Miller's leadership.

immigration.title: Automatic work permit extension ending; renewals now required
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: Finalized and in effect as of October 30, 2025: USCIS ended the automatic extension of employment authorization documents (EADs, Form I-766) for workers who timely filed renewal applications. Affected workers must now file affirmative renewal applications and cannot rely on automatic validity extensions during processing.

items.summary: Nvidia announced an independent board investigation into CEO Jensen Huang following reports he had an affair with a woman suspected by U.S. intelligence of spying for China. items.feedTitle: Oil falls on open as Trump says fresh Iran attacks 'unlikely'

cards.title: Control and Acceptance
cards.insight: The Stoics distinguished between what lies within our control (our judgments, desires, aversions) and what does not (external events, market swings, others' opinions). Markets fall and rise; your portfolio's future is partly yours to shape through discipline and partly contingent on forces beyond you.
cards.takeaway: Today, identify one financial worry outside your control (geopolitics, rate decisions) and consciously redirect effort to what you can govern—your spending, learning, and strategic positioning.

cards.title: Virtue as the Highest Good
cards.insight: Stoics held that virtue—wisdom, courage, justice, temperance—is the only true good. Wealth, status, and market gains are indifferents; they are neither good nor bad in themselves. A person of integrity who loses money honestly is more fortunate than a wealthy cheat.
cards.takeaway: When tempted by a risky shortcut to returns, ask: Does this compromise my integrity? Stoic wealth-building prioritizes character and long-term trustworthiness over quick wins.

cards.title: The Dichotomy of Desire
cards.insight: Seneca taught that we should examine whether our desires are natural (shelter, modest food) or vain (luxury, fame). Unnecessary craving leads to anxiety and poor decisions. The contentment of living simply on less is itself a kind of freedom.
cards.takeaway: Audit your spending this month: What do you buy out of genuine need versus social pressure or fear of missing out? Reduce the latter and notice the calm that follows.

cards.title: Amor Fati: Love of Fate
cards.insight: Rather than resisting what has happened—a market crash, a job loss—Stoics cultivated the stance of accepting reality fully and finding meaning within it. This is not resignation but fierce engagement with what is.
cards.takeaway: Reframe today's setback or loss: What skill, resilience, or clarity does this difficulty teach you? Channel frustration into learning and adaptation.
